p.title: Kabir and the puppy
p.challenge: Put the story in order: what happened first, next, then and last?
panels: One rainy evening, Kabir saw a small brown puppy shivering near the gate.
With Mummy's help, he dried it with an old towel.
He gave it a bowl of clean water and some rice.
Kabir named the puppy Sheru.
Now Sheru waits at the gate every afternoon when Kabir comes home from school.
In the evening, they play catch in the park.

'Let's have a race!' cried the little red car.
'Not so fast,' whispered the wooden horse. 'Tara is sleeping.'
So the toys played quietly until the sun came up.

p.title: Tara's wish
p.challenge: Put the story in order. How did Tara's wish come true?
panels: Tara wished she could ride a bicycle like her big brother, Dev.
Every evening, she put on her helmet and practised while Papa held the seat.
She fell many times, but she did not give up.
'Try again, beta,' said Dadi from the steps.
After two weeks, Papa let go, and Tara rode all by herself!
The whole family clapped and cheered.

p.title: Chanda Mama Counts the Stars
p.challenge: Put the story in order. Look for the numbers: ten, twenty, five!
panels: One night, Chanda Mama decided to count all the stars.
'One, two, three...' he began.
At ten, a little star giggled and hopped to another spot.
'Oh no! Now I must start again!' said Chanda Mama.
He counted to twenty, but a cloud floated by and hid five stars.
Chanda Mama laughed. 'Some things are too many to count, but they are lovely to look at!'
